name: Anklets of Alacrity
text:
These gem-studded golden anklets give you a +3 item bonus to Acrobatics checks. When you invest the anklets, you either increase your Dexterity modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you a higher value.

---

Activate A Interact

Frequency once per day

---

Effect You click the anklets together, gaining a +20-foot status bonus to all your Speeds and the effects of Water Walk for the next 10 minutes.

Effect: Anklets of Alacrity
